//: Ten for ten - one song per day for the last ten days of the wait.
Copy this file to songs.json in the same folder and fill it in. Both
songs.json and the audio files are gitignored: they are commercial
recordings, and on a free GitHub Pages plan the repo serving this page has
to be public. Keep them out of the repo.
The LENGTH sets the schedule, exactly as it does for the poem. Ten entries
start unlocking ten days out; four entries start four days out. The last
one lands on the final day of the wait, so all of them are hers on the
birthday itself. Ten is the maximum.
src     required, relative to this folder's parent (so 'songs/x.mp3')
artist  optional, shown in script under the title
cover   optional square image; without one the disc gets a plain blush face
note    optional one line of your own - why this song, for her
lyrics  optional; an array of lines, or one string with newlines in it.
Blank lines are kept as verse breaks. Leave it out and the sheet
says so instead - the player does not need it to work.

songs.title: Style
songs.note: day one, and it had to be this one
